timing: Subsequent reviewer clarification, after first disk and RHI outputs were inspected. No change to pre-existing numerical branches or decision criteria.
definition: Rg=Vflat^2/a0, converted to kpc. Use native per-galaxy a0 first, canonical and R142 fixed scales as sensitivity branches. RHI is measured neutral-gas radius and retains its own name. Verify per object log10(Rt/Rg)=-log10(at_flat/a0) and residual r=log10(at_flat/a0_ind)-0.352. Fit the requested fgas, log10(Rt/Rg), C82 models and disclose target leakage even on the held subset. With fixed a0 algebra also involves log10(a0_fixed/a0_ind). Independent predictors remain fgas, RHI/Rdisk and C82. Local V(Rt) gives an additional speed factor in the identity.
